pillars.subtitle: Three things the platform does well, so you don't have to build any of them.

1.title: Ready-made AI tools, no build required
1.body: Pick from tools the Chalyb team runs in production. Each one solves a specific job from day one.

welcome.body: This is your workspace. Here's the essentials in a minute — you can see it later or close it anytime.

faq.q1: What happens when my free month ends?
faq.a1: You continue on the plan you chose (yearly or monthly) and your card is charged. We email you 7 days before. If you cancel before, you pay nothing.
faq.q2: Can I switch from yearly to monthly?
faq.a2: Yes, from My account → My plan, whenever you want.
faq.a3: They’re what the tools use to work, for example each clip. Your plan brings new credits every month.
faq.q4: Can I cancel whenever I want?
faq.a4: Yes. It’s 1 click from My account. You keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for.
